Privacy & cookies

A little clarity
about your information.

How this website’s enquiry and course-preview features work.

Email enquiries

The enquiry form prepares a draft in your own email app. This website does not submit or store the details you type. If you send the email, it is delivered to The Snippitypip at thesnippitypip@hotmail.com and handled through its email service.

Online appointments

Appointment links open The Snippitypip’s Timely booking service. Appointments, gift vouchers, customer details, payment and any associated information are handled there, under the booking provider’s terms and privacy information.

Student and tutor account demonstration

The academy accounts use fictional student records and publicly displayed example credentials. They demonstrate the experience and do not provide secure live account authentication. Please use sample information only.

Course edits, lesson progress, notes, quiz results, case studies and tutor feedback are saved locally in your browser. Attached sample files and videos are held in browser storage (IndexedDB). They are not uploaded to a server or sent to a real tutor. Switching between the student and tutor examples uses the same local demonstration. Use “Reset demo” in the academy to remove this demonstration’s saved data and files. Signing out removes the current example session but keeps your demo work.

The original classroom preview also saves its progress locally. Its “Reset preview progress” button clears that separate progress. Neither demonstration represents enrolment, a formal assessment or an accredited qualification. The example certificate has no qualification status.

If you add a remote video link, the student video player loads that video from its host. YouTube links use the YouTube privacy-enhanced embed. The external video host may receive technical information when its player loads or plays.

Shop preview

The shop uses example products and illustrative prices. Its basket is saved in local browser storage under pip-shop-demo. Remove the items to empty it or clear site data to erase it. No orders, addresses or payment information are collected. Stripe checkout is not yet connected. Salon gift vouchers open the separate Timely service.

Cookies & other services

This website does not add advertising or analytics cookies. It uses Google Fonts to display its typefaces; your browser requests those files from Google. Hosting and sign-in services may process the technical information needed to provide access. External booking and social media sites have their own privacy and cookie settings.

Questions?

For an enquiry about information you send to The Snippitypip, email thesnippitypip@hotmail.com.
